name: Suzuki Bandit 1250
engine: 1255 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: The liquid-cooled Bandit. Some 2008-2009 bikes are in a regulator/rectifier recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2008-2009 GSF1250S bikes are in recall 16V018 for the regulator/rectifier.
A-002.reason: A dead regulator can leave you stranded. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier circuit board can lift off its case, so the battery stops charging and the engine can stall.
